supplements.title: Physalin A Suppresses Human Oral Squamous Carcinoma Cell Migration and Invasion Through Inhibiting Grb2/Ras and MMP/uPA Signaling Pathways.
supplements.summary: Physalin A, a natural compound, reduces oral cancer cell migration and invasion by blocking specific cellular signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Methionine Restriction Alone Induces T-cell-mediated Immunotherapy of Osteosarcoma in a Syngeneic Mouse Model.
supplements.summary: Restricting methionine alone effectively triggers the immune system to fight osteosarcoma in mice without additional treatments.

supplements.title: Mechanistic Studies of Anticancer Effects of Salicylaldehyde Benzoylhydrazone in 2D/3D Lung Cancer Cell Cultures.
supplements.summary: Salicylaldehyde benzoylhydrazone shows anticancer activity against lung cancer cells in both 2D and 3D culture models.

supplements.title: Cardioprotective and anti-inflammatory properties of blood flow restriction training in older or high-risk cardiovascular disease population: systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Blood flow restriction training combined with aerobic exercise safely improves heart health and reduces inflammation in elderly and high-risk cardiovascular patients.

supplements.title: Melittin Acts as a Radiosensitizer for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by Inhibiting the DNA Damage Repair System and Inducing Apoptosis.
supplements.summary: Melittin from bee venom makes lung cancer cells more vulnerable to radiation therapy by blocking their DNA repair abilities.

supplements.title: Arachidonic Acid and Lipoxin A4 Protect Pancreatic β-Cells and Improve Hyperglycemia Induced by Bleomycin.
supplements.summary: Arachidonic acid and lipoxin A4 protect pancreatic cells from bleomycin damage and reverse bleomycin-induced high blood sugar.

supplements.title: Nephroprotective Potential of Tectorigenin Against Thiamethoxam Instigated Renal Toxicity Via Regulating HMGB1/RAGE, TLR4/MyD88, and NF-κB Pathway in Sprague Dawley Rats: An In-Vivo and In-Silico Investigation.
supplements.summary: Tectorigenin protects rat kidneys from insecticide damage by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death.

supplements.title: Anti-cancer effect of palmitic acid against the endometrial cancer progression via inducing ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Palmitic acid slows endometrial cancer growth by triggering a specific type of cancer cell death called ferroptosis.

supplements.title: Trace mineral sources affect oxidized oil induced intestinal damage in chickens by modulation of gut microbiota and short-chain fatty acid metabolism.
supplements.summary: Organic trace minerals protect chickens from intestinal damage caused by oxidized oil by improving gut bacteria and beneficial metabolite production.

supplements.title: Polydatin as a Multifunctional Anticancer Agent: Cellular Mechanisms, Therapeutic Potential and Future Clinical Perspectives.
supplements.summary: Polydatin, a natural compound, shows promise in killing cancer cells and enhancing chemotherapy and radiotherapy effectiveness while reducing drug resistance.

supplements.title: Pinus morrisonicola induces cell-cycle arrest in human lung adenocarcinoma by modulating cyclins and cyclin-dependent kinases via p53-dependent signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Taiwan white pine extract stops lung cancer cell growth by activating p53 and blocking cell division.

supplements.title: Mangiferin Ameliorates Glutamate-Induced Excitatory Toxicity in SH-SY5Y Cells via Nrf2/HO-1 and Apoptosis Pathway.
supplements.summary: Mangiferin protects nerve cells from glutamate damage by reducing oxidative stress and preventing cell death through antioxidant pathways.

supplements.title: Resveratrol Supplementation and its Potential Benefits in Obesity-related Non-communicable Diseases.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol from grapes and berries shows promise for obesity-related diseases, but inconsistent trial results and product quality variations leave its true effectiveness unclear.

supplements.title: Overall Survival of Glioblastoma Patients Treated With a Combination of 7 Micronutrients: A Nutraceutical Trial.
supplements.summary: A combination of seven micronutrients improved overall survival in glioblastoma patients in this nutraceutical treatment trial.

supplements.title: Molecular Mechanisms Underlying the Anti-Cancer Effects of Tangeretin, a Phytochemical from Citrus Extracts.
supplements.summary: Tangeretin, a compound from citrus fruits, shows promise fighting cancer by triggering cell death and reducing cancer stem cells.

off_label.title: Oral Administration of Itraconazole Induces M1 Polarization of Tumor-associated Macrophages in Gynecological Cancer.
off_label.summary: Oral antifungal drug itraconazole shifts immune cells in gynecological cancers toward anti-tumor activity.

off_label.title: Targeting mutant VHL-gene results in therapy response in metastatic clear cell carcinoma of rete testis.
off_label.summary: Targeting a mutant VHL gene with belzutifan drug achieved complete remission in a rare metastatic testis cancer patient.

off_label.title: Impact of Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitors on Disease Symptoms in Patients with Chronic Myeloproliferative Neoplasms.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors may reduce inflammation-related symptoms in patients with chronic myeloproliferative neoplasms by controlling the overactive renin-angiotensin system.

off_label.title: IGSF9 promotes immunotherapy resistance in colon cancer by orchestrating an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and enables combinatorial targeting strategies.
off_label.summary: IGSF9 promotes immunotherapy resistance in colon cancer; combining MAPK inhibitor Doramapimod with anti-PD-1 therapy overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Intralesional bevacizumab injection for symptomatic glomus tumors of the hand: A prospective pilot study.
off_label.summary: Injecting bevacizumab directly into hand glomus tumors reduced pain and may offer an alternative to surgery.

off_label.title: Effect of linezolid combined with N-acetylcysteine on lung function, blood gas and inflammation in patients with severe pneumonia.
off_label.summary: Combining linezolid with N-acetylcysteine improved lung function and reduced inflammation in severe pneumonia patients better than antibiotics alone.

off_label.title: Regulation of ferroptosis in colorectal cancer through therapeutic modulation and miRNA targeting.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified genes and microRNAs that control ferroptosis in colorectal cancer, revealing potential drug combinations for new treatment strategies.

off_label.title: Glucocorticoid signaling mitigates colitis-associated visceral hypersensitivity by suppressing 5-HT release in enterochromaffin cells via a GR-PI3K-SGK1 axis.
off_label.summary: Glucocorticoids reduce gut pain sensitivity in colitis by lowering serotonin production in intestinal cells through a specific signaling pathway.

off_label.title: Advances in Cardiovascular Pharmacotherapy. VI. Sacubitril-Valsartan, An Angiotensin Receptor-Neprilysin Inhibitor.
off_label.summary: This is not cancer research. The article reviews sacubitril-valsartan, a heart failure medication, with only a brief mention of chemotherapy-related heart damage as one application area.

off_label.title: Afatinib inhibits esophageal squamous cell carcinoma by regulating ferroptosis and NRF2 protein homeostasis.
off_label.summary: Afatinib fights esophageal cancer by triggering a cell-death process involving iron and protein regulation.

off_label.title: Artemisinin sensitizes triple negative breast cancer to immune checkpoint therapy through suppressing KEAP1-mediated PD-L1 degradation.
off_label.summary: Artemisinin boosts triple-negative breast cancer's immune checkpoint therapy response by increasing PD-L1 protein levels on tumor cells.

off_label.title: Impact of Proton Pump Inhibitor Use on the Efficacy of IO-IO Versus IO-TKI Therapy in Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Proton pump inhibitors may reduce the effectiveness of immune-based treatments for metastatic kidney cancer.

off_label.title: Identifying Drugs Associated With Parkinson's Disease Risk Using Machine Learning.
off_label.summary: Machine learning identified inhalant anticholinergics, antimalarials, and antibiotics as potentially protective against Parkinson's disease risk.

off_label.title: Effect of apatinib on albendazole metabolism in vitro and in vivo.
off_label.summary: Apatinib inhibits albendazole metabolism in laboratory and animal studies, potentially increasing albendazole levels when drugs are used together.

off_label.title: Indomethacin alleviates acute pancreatitis by restoring autophagic flux via the AMPK signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Indomethacin reduces acute pancreatitis damage by activating autophagy through the AMPK signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Mass Cytometry Workflow to Achieve High-Dimensional Immunophenotyping in Resource-Limited or Decentralized Environments.
biomarkers.summary: New workflow enables advanced immune testing for lung cancer patients in remote and resource-limited communities without specialized equipment.

biomarkers.title: Successful Management of Suspected Epstein-Barr Virus-Associated Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis in BRAF-Mutant Cholangiocarcinoma Following Treatment With Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors and BRAF/MEK Inhibitors: A Case Report.
biomarkers.summary: Combination immune and BRAF inhibitor therapy helped treat a rare cholangiocarcinoma case, though it triggered a serious immune side effect requiring careful management.

biomarkers.title: Multiomic characterization of small cell lung cancer: Real-world insights into therapeutic opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified four distinct small cell lung cancer subtypes based on specific proteins, revealing some tumors have more immune cells, offering new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Biomarker-directed aptamer panels for diagnosis and differentiation of neuroendocrine tumors.
biomarkers.summary: RNA aptamer panels successfully identified neuroendocrine tumors and distinguished intestinal from pancreatic types using blood biomarkers.

biomarkers.title: A trial of risk-adapted prostate cancer screening in a federally supported health center network serving a high-risk population.
biomarkers.summary: A trial tested risk-adapted prostate cancer screening guidelines in clinics serving high-risk Black communities to improve screening practices and outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Dacomitinib as a First-Line Therapy for Advanced EGFR-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Without Brain Metastases: A Multicenter Retrospective Observational Study.
biomarkers.summary: Dacomitinib shows promise as an effective first-line treatment for advanced lung cancer patients with specific genetic mutations.

biomarkers.title: Dysregulated Peroxiredoxins in Bladder Cancer Are Associated With an Altered Tumour Immune Microenvironment.
biomarkers.summary: High PRDX1 and PRDX6 levels predict poor outcomes in bladder cancer and could help guide immunotherapy treatment strategies.

biomarkers.title: Anti-CD146 Autoantibodies: The First Biologic Markers Associated With Occupational Exposure in Systemic Sclerosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified anti-CD146 antibodies as a biological marker linking occupational exposure to systemic sclerosis development.

biomarkers.summary: Oral antifungal drug itraconazole shifts immune cells in gynecological cancers toward anti-tumor activity.

biomarkers.summary: PSMA PET/CT imaging effectively diagnoses and stages high-grade prostate cancer in a single procedure, reducing costs compared to traditional multi-step approaches.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic Role of Inflammatory Blood Cell Ratios in Glioblastoma Patients: Insights from a Single-institution Study.
biomarkers.summary: Blood cell ratios may help predict survival outcomes in glioblastoma patients undergoing standard treatment.
